name: Acquisition Analysis (Acquirer Side)
description: Independent acquisition analysis supporting the acquirer's management and board: standalone valuation, synergies, structure, financing, returns, risks, and offer strategy.
provider_note: OpenAI Responses or an OpenAI-compatible synchronous CommonStack gateway; configured server-side. Live research and ATL registration are not yet verified.

fields.label: Acquirer Company
fields.description: Include identifiers sufficient to distinguish the entity.

fields.label: Target Company
fields.description: Include identifiers sufficient to distinguish the entity.

fields.label: Research Cut-off Date
fields.description: Latest date up to which information may be considered.

fields.label: Valuation Date
fields.description: If omitted, the runtime uses the research cut-off date. Disclose justified exceptions.

fields.label: Report Currency
fields.description: Preserve source currencies and disclose conversions.

fields.label: What is the deal background?
fields.description: Describe the opportunity, transaction history, current status, and decision to be supported.
fields.placeholder: Describe the opportunity, transaction history, current status, and decision to be supported.

fields.label: What are BuyCo's objectives?
fields.description: Describe the strategic, operating, or financial objectives and why acquisition is being considered.
fields.placeholder: Describe the strategic, operating, or financial objectives and why acquisition is being considered.

fields.label: Are any price or terms proposed?
fields.description: Provide any proposed consideration, value definition, payment mechanics, perimeter, and material terms. State if no offer exists.
fields.placeholder: Provide any proposed consideration, value definition, payment mechanics, perimeter, and material terms. State if no offer exists.

fields.label: What are the funding and return requirements?
fields.description: Provide any financing constraints, liquidity needs, capital-allocation priorities, or defined return requirements.
fields.placeholder: Provide any financing constraints, liquidity needs, capital-allocation priorities, or defined return requirements.

fields.label: What financials and forecasts are available?
fields.description: Identify available statements, forecasts, assumptions, periods, and their sources. Distinguish management forecasts from analyst scenarios.
fields.placeholder: Identify available statements, forecasts, assumptions, periods, and their sources. Distinguish management forecasts from analyst scenarios.

fields.label: What are the integration priorities?
fields.description: Describe integration objectives, priorities, constraints, retention concerns, and known dependencies.
fields.placeholder: Describe integration objectives, priorities, constraints, retention concerns, and known dependencies.

fields.label: What approvals and deadlines apply?
fields.description: Identify known approvals, decision dates, contractual deadlines, and timing constraints.
fields.placeholder: Identify known approvals, decision dates, contractual deadlines, and timing constraints.

fields.label: What are the negotiation priorities?
fields.description: Identify price, payment, protections, control, timing, or other priorities and any explicit limits.
fields.placeholder: Identify price, payment, protections, control, timing, or other priorities and any explicit limits.

fields.label: What documents are available, and what's in scope?
fields.description: List available documents and locations, access restrictions, included work, and exclusions. Listing a document does not establish that the runtime can access it.
fields.placeholder: List available documents and locations, access restrictions, included work, and exclusions. Listing a document does not establish that the runtime can access it.
